cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_date_time_worker C CXX)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
target_sources(cui PRIVATE "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/src/base/cui_date_time_picker.c")
add_executable(test_date_time_picker "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_date_time_picker.c")
target_link_libraries(test_date_time_picker PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(test_date_time_picker)
add_test(NAME date_time_picker COMMAND test_date_time_picker)
add_library(date_time_header OBJECT header.cpp)
target_link_libraries(date_time_header PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(date_time_header)
set_property(TARGET date_time_header PROPERTY CXX_STANDARD 11)
